display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 450px; text-align: center;

span.p:
PostgreSQL Database
- shared_buffers = 32 GB
- max_connections = 400
- Streaming replica in same AZ (async)
- WAL archive to S3
- Point-in-time recovery (7 day retention)
cgroup: cpu.shares=2048, memory=128GB

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 450px; text-align: center; width: 450px;

span.p:
Storage Layer
- OS/data: /dev/nvme0n1 (NVMe, 2 TB, ext4)
- WAL: /dev/nvme1n1 (NVMe, 500 GB, XFS, noatime)
- Backups: /dev/xvdba (EBS gp3, 4 TB, nightly)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 450px; text-align: center; width: 450px;

span.p:
Instance: r7g.8xlarge (32 vCPU, 256 GB RAM, EBS-optimized)
Cost: ~$1,800/month (instance + storage + ALB + CDN)
User scale: 50,000 to 200,000

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 450px; text-align: center; width: 450px;

span.p:
Application Server (Gunicorn + Python / Go binary)
- 8 workers (Gunicorn) / 16 goroutines (Go)
- Connection pool to database (size 20)
- Redis client pool (size 10)
- Circuit breaker on DB (5 failures → 30s open)
cgroup: cpu.shares=2048, memory=8GB

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 450px; text-align: center; width: 450px;

span.p:
Redis Cache (in-memory session store + query cache)
- 64 GB maxmemory, allkeys-lru eviction
- Persistence: RDB snapshots every 5 minutes
- maxclients: 5,000
cgroup: cpu.shares=512, memory=64GB

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 450px; text-align: center;

span.p:
CloudFront / CDN
(Edge caching of static assets)

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 450px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Elastic Load Balancer (ALB)
- TLS termination
- Rate limiting (1,000 req/s per client)
- Health check on /health

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 450px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Nginx Reverse Proxy (on instance: port 80/443)
- Static file serving
- SSL termination (or pass through to ALB)
- Request buffering
- Rate limit per route
cgroup: cpu.shares=1024, memory=1GB
